`standardFormat` builds the note format with POST /api/formats/standard, so

`laterNotes` are the same patient's sessions AFTER the one being refined —
the shape of the 2026-09-23 leak, where the model 'corrected' an older

note.Client presentation: Reports sleep has been better this week, about six hours a night.
note.Discussion: She wanted to talk about her sister's wedding next month and seeing her ex there, which took most of the hour. We also talked a bit about work; her manager has been giving her more responsibility and she feels good about it. She asked about my weekend and we chatted for a minute, not clinically relevant.
note.Intervention: Cognitive restructuring around the worry about the ex.
note.Out of session actions: Write down her worries each evening before the next session.
note.Note for next session: Panic attacks decreased from three a week back in August to one this week. Sessions continue weekly.

scenarios.why: The owner's 2026-09-23 refine pass, in her order, on one note: (a) 'make the discussion shorter' came back `applied` with the Discussion held back and Location rewritten from the patient's NEXT session's note; (b) 'add that she's on sertraline 20 mg' came back `applied` with the medication missing and an unrequested Discussion sentence deleted; (c) 'remove the risk review' cleared the Note for next session too and the reply invented a sertraline removal.

turns.message: Add that she's on sertraline 20 mg

scenarios.why: The owner's exact 2026-09-23 (a) setup: the patient's only other note is the NEXT session's, and it says the session was on video. Asked to shorten the Discussion, the model 'corrected' Location from 'In person' to 'Video' out of that note. A later session is never context for an earlier one.
